title: Chapter 303 - 303 Surprised; Look Down On!

Chapter 303 - 303 Surprised; Look Down On!

Chapter 303 - 303 Surprised; Look Down On!

303 Surprised; Look Down On!

The employees of Fan Yu Investment finally boarded Solange with endless anticipation and surprise.

Just by looking at the exterior of Solange, everyone was already amazed.

When they arrived on the yacht, everyone’s mouths were wide open.

A spacious restaurant, bar, high-end KTV, spa, surround-sound cinema, heated swimming pool, luxurious lounge… There was everything that one could dream of!

How was this a yacht?

It was a moving castle!

Lin Fan said, “On the yacht, everything you eat, drink, play, and use… will be provided for free!”

Then, Lin Fan said, “Set sail!”

After the engine roared, the entire luxury yacht was like a dragon that braved the wind and waves as it flew into the distance.

At the same time, the employees of Fan Yu Investment cheered enthusiastically.

Some of them jumped into the heated swimming pool enthusiastically.

Some lay on rattan chairs and rested comfortably.

Some walked into the spa to relax.

…

Soon, the entire luxury yacht was filled with excited discussions.

“Remy Martin, Ace of Hearts! There are actually tens of thousands of bottles of good liquor on the ship! Heavens!”

“Japanese beef, king crab, Australian lobster, sea cucumber, abalone… Moreover, it was so delicious! It’s really delicious!”

“The spa is too comfortable!”

…

Solange had just arrived at the port of Modu yesterday. It was difficult for ordinary people to store so much food and wine immediately.

However, Lin Fan owned the three-star Michelin restaurant, Fumando, so it was naturally very simple.

In fact, this was also the reason why everyone felt that the food was delicious.

One had to know…

The food was cooked by a chef from a three-star Michelin restaurant. How could the taste be bad?

Qin Yuxuan lay on the chair and looked at the boundless sea in the distance. She felt relaxed and happy.

She listened to the sounds of the employees playing around, and her gaze fell on Lin Fan. She slowly leaned over.

Happiness, satisfaction, sweetness!

…

In fact, Solange was not the only yacht on the sea at this time.

Not far away, there was also a yacht floating.

Of course, this yacht was far inferior to Solange in terms of size and luxury.

A group of men and women were standing on the deck of the yacht, enjoying the sea breeze and drinking wine. Their expressions were very smug.

“Fine wine, delicious food, five-star suites… All of them! Young Master Liu, your yacht is really good!” A round-faced man praised.

“Of course!” Liu Sheng said proudly. “I spent 300 million yuan to buy this yacht from Brazil. There’s no better yacht in the entire Modu!”

“Young Master Huang seems to be very satisfied with this yacht. Congratulations, Young Master Liu!” the round-faced man said.

Liu Sheng said, “We’re all playing and having fun together. What’s there to congratulate?”

Even though he said so, the smile on his face clearly showed that he was in agreement! This was something worth congratulating!

At this moment, a luxurious, magnificent, and extremely cool yacht suddenly sailed over from afar.

Someone immediately shouted, “F*ck!” What a cool yacht!”

“And it’s so big!”

“This can even be called a moving castle!”

Many people stood up and clicked their tongues in wonder.

Liu Sheng’s face was a little dark.

He had just said that there was no yacht better than his in Modu.

However, a yacht that far surpassed his appeared almost immediately?

Did he have to be slapped in the face like this?

At this moment, the round-faced man beside him shouted, “Hey, friends, are you from Modu too? Is this a banquet?”

An employee said, “We’re from Fan Yu Investment, and this is a team-building event.”

Team-building event?

The round-faced man was stunned

On such a luxurious yacht?

Also, he had never heard of Fan Yu Investment before.

Liu Sheng’s expression turned slightly better when he heard that.

A team-building event for an unknown small company…

Then, perhaps this yacht was just for show.

Moreover, it was definitely rented!

Hence, Liu Sheng slowly raised his head and looked into Solange.

In the next moment…

Liu Sheng’s eyes lit up slightly as they locked onto Qin Yuxuan on the deck.

What a beauty!

What a perfect figure!

Exquisite facial features!

However, he saw Lin Fan hugging Qin Yuxuan.

Liu Sheng immediately felt a strong sense of jealousy.

Why?

Why did such a beautiful woman become someone else’s woman?

Just because he was handsome?

Liu Sheng took a deep breath and shouted at Lin Fan, “Bro, you should have heard of Fenglin Real Estate, right? That’s my family’s. My name is Liu Sheng. It’s rare for us to meet today. How about being friends?

“In the future, if you want to use a yacht, you can use this luxury yacht that I bought from Brazil for 300 million yuan.”

The rich second-generation heirs in movies and novels were mostly unreasonable.

In reality, though?

Most of them were very smart like Liu Sheng.

Although his target was Qin Yuxuan, he was introducing himself to Lin Fan and mentioned how powerful his family was and how they owned an expensive yacht.

He believed that Lin Fan would be like a pug, wagging his tail and begging for mercy.

On the other hand, Qin Yuxuan would be endlessly in love with him and want to cling to him.

This… was the charm of money!

Liu Sheng had many similar experiences. He believed that this time would not be an exception.

However…

What Liu Sheng did not know was that after he said those words, Lin Fan just casually glanced at him as if he was looking at an idiot.

A luxury yacht worth 300 million yuan?

A mere 300 million yuan was enough for a ship to be considered a luxury yacht?

His yacht was worth 1.2 billion yuan!

Could he not see the difference between his yacht and this one?

Why was he so blindly confident?

“Fenglin Real Estate?” Lin Fan said calmly. “Never heard of it.

“As for making friends? Not interested.”

He was not spouting nonsense.

Fenglin Real Estate was indeed quite famous in Modu.

However, Lin Fan was not from Modu. Other than the famous Tomson Building, he had not heard of any other places.

Liu Sheng’s face darkened.

He did not expect Lin Fan to reply like this.

“Bro, I’ve already introduced myself. Aren’t you looking down on me by not replying?”

Lin Fan raised his eyes and said, “You can tell? I am looking down on you a little.”

He was not spouting nonsense.

One had to know… With Lin Fan’s current status, there were not many people that he looked up to.

Of course, under normal circumstances, Lin Fan would not say that.

It was mainly because he had seen through his evil intentions for Qin Yuxuan.

Since that was the case, Lin Fan naturally would not hold back either.
